summary: Tested the new eBay listing-status auto-inactivation feature end-to-end (backend + frontend). All 9 pytest cases in test_stock_status_and_archive.py pass (scraper classifier: ended/sold/out_of_stock/live; archive hides product from default list; archived=true endpoint returns only archived; restore does not re-activate sold; archive 404 on unknown). Frontend: All Products correctly grays out (opacity-60) sold/ended/out-of-stock rows, renders SOLD / ENDED / OUT OF STOCK badges via [data-testid=product-badge-<id>], and shows Archive + Delete + Edit buttons. Clicking Archive on the sold row removes it from All Products; the Archived tab shows it with a Restore [data-testid=archived-restore-<id>] + Delete button. Restoring a sold product returns it to All Products still grayed-out with a SOLD badge (does not re-activate). Price Alerts page hides all is_sold / non-live items and shows the excluded strip ('1 sold / ended / out-of-stock listing excluded') via [data-testid=price-alerts-excluded]; Items tracked reflects live-only count.

issues: `grayscale` class is applied to the thumbnail image only (line 3305), not the whole row — visually acceptable but the review spec wording suggested full-row grayscale. Non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: App.js is very large (>4000 lines) — Products/ArchivedProducts/PriceAlertsView should be split into separate component files for maintainability.
statusBadge() classifier logic in App.js should live alongside a shared constants file so backend and frontend stay in sync when a new stock_status value is added.
seed_data_creation: None — used the pre-seeded 3 inactive-stock + 1 archived product. Test flow archived then restored the sold product (34f58131...) — it is now back in All Products in its original inactive state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All feature acceptance criteria pass. If retesting, note that the sold product 34f58131-4b26-442f-a18a-cb02b556e038 was archived+restored during this run — it is now unarchived (archived=False) and still active=False, stock_status=sold, so the archived tab has only the original 49bcf5af... item.
